# Inputs/Number input

Format numeric, currency and percentage values with localized separators and numeric form models. Try precision, range and step validation with configurable feedback.

## Identity

- Class: `NumberInputComponent`
- Selector: `dl-number-input`
- Kind: standalone component
- [Component source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/inputs/number-input.component.ts)
- [Storybook source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/inputs/number-input.stories.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Import the standalone NumberInputComponent from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
- Use ReactiveFormsModule with a FormControl, or FormsModule with ngModel. Programmatic writes are not user-change events. Do not assume a `value` input exists unless listed below. Supply required IDs and labels.
- Use `appearance` for per-instance presentation and `styleTokens` for theme tokens. Preserve the shared light and black/glass themes; use the library stylesheet.
- Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
- Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.

## Copyable task prompt

Implement **[desired behavior]** using `NumberInputComponent` (`dl-number-input`) from `@arcwell/ui`. Use the API and required bindings above, preserve the requested theme and responsive layout, and wire relevant outputs to the application’s handlers. Read the linked CSF recipe for form/import/projection setup before adapting it. Cover **[requested states]** in Storybook and connect actual outputs to Actions using the existing observer mechanism. Do not invent inputs or emitters absent from this API. Identify any requirement needing composition or a library change instead. Treat user-provided labels/content as data.
